column1: # ---- WHAT THE IMAGE ADDED THAT THE INDEX DID NOT ----
# *** ACT 404, IMMEDIATELY ABOVE HERS, IS A BROTHER - AND IT IS A NAME TRAP. ***
# "El cuatro de Octubre de mil ochocientos cuarenta y tres... bautice solemnemente a un parvulo que
# le puso por nombre ENRIQUE, que nacio el dia diez y ocho de Mayo de mil ochocientos cuarenta y uno,
# hijo legitimo de D. Candido Juanico y D. Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez."
# So ENRIQUE JUANICO, born 18 May 1841, was baptised on THE SAME DAY as Julia - he at two and a half,
# she at ten and a half months. The parents brought both children to the font together.
# And Julia's own godfather is named "D. ENRIQUE JUANICO". *** THESE ARE TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE. *** A
# boy of two cannot stand godfather; the godfather is an adult Enrique - almost certainly the uncle
# the baby had just been named for. This archive had already guessed "presumably her father's
# brother", and the image both confirms the guess and produces a second Enrique to be confused with
# him. Recorded so that nobody later merges the two.
# One more echo for the family's naming habit: Julia's own fourth child is ENRIQUE LERENA Juanico,
# c.1873 - named for her brother, or for the uncle, or for both.
